title: App-side preview lifecycle (update_preview / disarm_preview / U-key) has zero automated coverage
detail: The shipped acceptance-2 path's input half — gen-recompute trigger, five disarm paths, buffer ownership — runs only in the untested app; the harness reimplements arming (harness/run.odin:271) and bypasses app/main.odin, so a stale-preview or leak regression passes CI.
recommended_fix: Extract update_preview's should-recompute/should-disarm decision into a pure core proc with @(test) pins (the B1 pattern used for forecast_summarize/preview_next_tier), leaving app code a thin call.

title: Singular-verb and overflow-tail render branches of the preview card are pixel-unpinned
detail: All four golden cards render count==2 rows with overflow 0, so "1 route reroutes/consolidates", "1 route split", and the "+N more" tail never render in any golden; a conjugation or tail regression would pass CI. Only the core counting is pinned.
recommended_fix: Add a golden capture with a count-1 reroute/merge row and one forcing overflow (>12 distinct buckets), or unit-test preview_row_line's branches directly.

detail: All four captures fall at ticks 600-660 inside the era-3 surge forecast window [600,3000), so a weather row is always drawn above the preview; the preview-alone-at-top branch (rows==0) renders in no golden.
recommended_fix: Add one forecast_preview capture after tick 3000 (surge window over, forecast empty) with a preview armed, pinning the top-positioned card layout.

title: Harness preview-directive error paths uncovered and the unknown-verb help text omits the new verb
detail: The new verb's fail-loud paths (bad parse, pipe not live at capture, forecast rejected) are exercised by no demo — forecast_preview.dem's directives are all valid — and the unknown-verb help text still lists the pre-R4 verb set.
recommended_fix: Append "preview" to the want-list string; optionally add a negative demo (dead pipe / illegal tier) asserting the demo fails loudly.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence:
odin test core (run at the reviewed sha): "Finished 135 tests in 501.287ms. All tests were successful."
core/forecast_shift_test.odin: 9 new @(test) procs (split/reroute/merge, honest-prediction pin, purity+determinism, errors+no-change, W1 parallel-attract, summarize+next-tier, N5 same-cost).
git diff v2..HEAD --name-status: goldens/ shows only A (added) entries — no existing golden modified.
detail: P0 100%: helper happy+error paths, purity, determinism, honest-prediction pin, and golden discipline all pinned. P1 ~85-90%: panel golden (four card states) + core summarize/next-tier pins full; app U-key lifecycle unpinned. Overall >80%.
recommended_fix: Pin the app seam (pure core proc for update_preview/disarm decisions + @(test)) and add goldens for singular-verb, overflow-tail, and empty-weather branches to reach PASS.
